subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: After real Teams delivery proof is attached, should this PR become the canonical Microsoft Teams fix instead of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867?
rationale: Both branches implement the same user-visible delivery behavior; choosing the permanent test shape and branch is an ownership decision, while neither is currently proof-complete.

options.title: Prefer this PR
options.body: Keep the non-exporting adapter change and stronger `deliverOutboundPayloads` boundary coverage, require live Teams proof, then close the older overlap.

options.title: Prefer the older PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 if maintainers prefer its smaller test surface, but require equivalent live Teams proof before merge.

options.title: Replace both branches
options.body: Create a maintainer-owned replacement only if current-main delivery refactors make both existing test shapes unsuitable.

recommendation.title: Prefer this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the non-exporting adapter change and stronger `deliverOutboundPayloads` boundary coverage, require live Teams proof, then close the older overlap.

likelyOwner.reason: The sibling Tlon sanitizer replacement and foundational Teams outbound history make this the strongest available owner for selecting the canonical branch.
